Lieutenant Messina finally submitted her report on the subject of cargo transports, and the evidence was circumstantial at best.

Most of it seemed to imply that a handful of soldiers have been making a number of unauthorized requests, ranging from snacks to blasters. This, of course, is unacceptable and a full investigation will be required. 

However, our focus right now has to be the project deadlines and shoring up station security and safety protocols. We stop the source, and the soldiers will fall in line.
